text: Death is a transformation caused by a specific type of external communication, just as the loss of memory and other such conditions in others arise from the will of a pishacha (demon) or similar entity. Indeed, due to the will of a pishacha or similar entity, others experience loss of memory, dreams, possession by spirits, and various afflictions. Similarly, such effects can arise from the power of the mind, just as the power of a siddhi does. For example, Sarana experienced visions in dreams due to the influence of the great Kātyāyana.
